## 1c. ln K anchored separately at every temperature

eps_b (kJ/mol) solving ln K_p(T) exactly at each temperature (k_b = 580; KF families keep w of the 298 K anchor). A temperature-independent potential that describes the reaction needs one eps_b for all T. 'worst transfer': rms ln K error over all nine temperatures of the potential anchored at the worst single temperature. ## 2. Many-body penalty, real track (pair potential fixed)

Hard criteria: every two-bond geometry lies above the dimer-monomer van der Waals complex (worst dE_vdw >= -0.5 kJ/mol, nothing invisible to the counter) and |d lnK| < 0.01 from the term's action on isolated pairs. Then preferred: exact pair invariance, no trimer trap living > 1 ps, native LAMMPS form (eam/fs), lowest trimer content, fewest parameters.
